prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you referred to soccer as 'football' in a public establishment. Respond to the committee.
response:
*Adjusts microphone, wipes sweat from forehead, and looks nervously at the panel of men in Hawaiian shirts and pitmaster aprons.*

Mr. Chairman, Esteemed Members of the Cookout Division, I come before you today a deeply humbled, but fiercely loyal American. 

I am aware of the grave allegations leveled against me. It has been stated by a confidential informant—whom I strongly suspect is my brother-in-law, Gary, still bitter over our fantasy league dispute—that on the afternoon of Saturday, October 14th, in a public Buffalo Wild Wings, I pointed to a television screen and referred to a match of Association Soccer as "football."

I will not insult this committee by pleading the Fifth. I will tell you the truth. 

The word did leave my lips. But I beg this committee to consider the context. I was a victim of circumstance, exhaustion, and subversive European trickery! 

I had just finished a brutal shift. I was disoriented. I looked up at the screen, and I saw a man in a brightly colored jersey take a dive after barely being touched. Naturally, my deeply ingrained American instincts kicked in, and I assumed I was watching a roughing-the-passer penalty in the NFL! When I yelled, "Come on, that's ruining football!", it was a cry of passion for the gridiron, not an endorsement of the metric system!

Furthermore, I have spent my entire life standing against the very Euro-snobbery this committee was built to destroy. I ask you to look at my record! 

Are you now, or have you ever been, a fan of 0-0 ties? *No!*
Have I ever referred to a field as a "pitch"? *Never!*
Have I ever called a jersey a "kit" or cleats "boots"? *I would rather swallow a lit charcoal briquette!*

Gentlemen, I bleed red, white, and blue-cheese dressing. I own a Traeger smoker. I use hickory wood, not pellets. I have never—*never*—put raisins in a potato salad. I believe in the forward pass, the 4th-and-goal conversion, and the constitutional right to consume 4,000 calories in a stadium parking lot before noon!

If this committee is looking to root out true Un-American Cookout activity, I direct your attention to my neighbor, Kevin. Just last Labor Day, Kevin brought plant-based sausages to a neighborhood block party and attempted to serve them on a *ciabatta roll*. 

I name names, Mr. Chairman! Kevin is the true subversive! 

I ask this committee for leniency. Do not strip me of my grilling tongs. Do not place my name on the Blacklist of the Big Green Egg. I am a patriot. God bless the NFL. God bless cholesterol. And God bless the United States of America.
